pieces.Text: /day, the gunmaster can resolve an attack against touch AC instead of normal AC when firing one increment beyond his firearm's first range increment. The gunmaster still takes the -2 penalty on attack rolls for shooting a target outside the firearm's first range increment. A gunmaster can spend multiple daily uses to resolve an attack at a further range increment (for instance, he can spend three uses to resolve an attack three increments beyond his first range increment).
